HPE Adds Former JPMorgan Exec to Board, Amends Agreement With Elliott Investment

Hewlett Packard Enterprise amended its cooperation agreement to allow it to add Jennifer Nason to the board

By

Hewlett Packard Enterprise amended its cooperation agreement with Elliott Investment Management to allow it to add Jennifer Nason to the board.

The amendment allows HPE HPE 3.17 % increase; up pointing triangle to have up to 15 directors on its board until its 2027 annual meeting. After the meeting, it will be limited to 13 directors, per HPE’s filing Wednesday.
